audience: immigration law firms that track client cases in Docketwise

useCases.title: Review the matters of the firm and their status
useCases.text: List the matters of the firm and read the number, title and status of each one. Open one matter to see its client, receipts and notes.

useCases.title: Check the USCIS receipts of a case
useCases.text: Find the matter by its number or title. List its USCIS receipts to see each receipt number, description and latest status update.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and the charges on them
useCases.text: List the invoices of the firm and read the status and balance of each one. Open the charges of an invoice to see each service, expense and fee.

useCases.title: Find a client document and get a download link
useCases.text: Search the documents by title and read the details of one document. Get a download link that works for one hour, and share it only with the person who asked.

useCases.title: Add or correct a note on a matter
useCases.text: Add a note to a matter or a client, for example a list of missing documents. Update the title or text of a note when the facts change.

useCases.title: Open a new matter for a new client
useCases.text: Create a contact for the new client. Read the firm users, then create a matter for that client and assign the users who work on it.
